notes.title: 2024 Summer : Progress announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Due to ample time, our scheduled progress has been significantly advanced. We are excited to share a sneak peek of the content that has completed the first phase of testing at the end of this scorching summer.

[h2]Prologue ~ Chapter 1[/h2] (Early Access Part)
[h3]Modifications/Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a guide item “Zheng Ning’s Commission Notebook”. If you haven’t obtained it, just go home and sleep on the left side of the bed to get it.
[*] Terrain adjustments and added an early leveling area “Goblin Town”.
[*] Adjusted some story performances.
[*] Optimized some event programs for slightly better performance.
[*] Fixed some minor errors.
[*] Increased the strength of enemies in “Deep in the Marsal Forest” and “Fourth Floor of the Wuer Cave”, and modified the conditions for triggering related stories.
[/list]

[h2]Chapter 2[/h2]
[h3]Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduction of enemies with special abilities or high attribute resistances.
[*] Branching storylines where the success or failure of preliminary tasks will affect subsequent plots.
[*] New companions for the Mage and Hunter, expanding tactical options. [spoiler](You might even one-shot strong enemies if you're lucky)[/spoiler]
[*] Release of growth items and new equipment, including limited-time powerful weapons!!
[*] New special skills to make cleaning up easier.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047035/1a6a949b0098c452b88d8316c83ce187cb5411e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047035/ff7dc15a00e2a0b2e0a922e53c670f6afc66c6d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047035/de4caafc51aab0d94e29a484ce18c5f8f6ded0fe.png[/img]

[h2]Chapters 3 ~ 4[/h2]
[h3]Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Expanded free exploration areas and secret treasures protected by guardians.
[*] Main quests with flexible completion times.
[*] New companions joining, along with those adventurers hiding in the corners.
[*] More special skills and powerful weapons, don’t miss out!
[*] Arena and job change trials awaiting strong challengers.
[*] Item “OOO’s Travel Alchemy Kit”, so you never have to worry about finding a potion shop while on the go.
[/list]
